notes.title: Devlog 2: Daily Life of a Cult Mayor and Card System
notes.content:
Welcome back to the development log of "Back of Beyond"! Today we'll dive into the game's turn system and follower card management.

In Mist Town, each round represents a day's work for the mayor (the player). You need to achieve faith goals in limited rounds, or the dark gods will punish the town. We aim for gameplay that's fast-paced and strategic, requiring players to balance between faith accumulation and resource management.

Turn System:

Each turn grants limited action points to activate buildings and use followers
At the end of a turn, new followers are drawn from the deck to fill empty spaces
Every five turns, a faith check occurs - you must reach specific faith values to survive
You can spend money to cut down trees and expand land, creating space for more followers and buildings


Follower cards are the core system of the game. Each follower has their own color and characteristics, providing different resources for the town. White followers are more common, red followers excel at generating faith, while blue followers bring in more money. As the game progresses, players can purchase more powerful followers through the shop, gradually strengthening their deck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518402/bdba0565726683357828244cd917a681797fb842.png

We've also designed a "replacement value" system, allowing players to replace unsuitable followers on the field a limited number of times. This adds more depth to gameplay, giving players more strategic considerations in deck cycling and position adjustment.

In the next development log, we'll share the design concepts and strategic uses of various buildings in the game! If you're interested in "Back of Beyond," please add the game to your wishlist: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539480/Back_of_Beyond/

notes.title: Devlog 1: The Cult Town in the Mist
notes.content:
We are excited to introduce our game in development, "Back of Beyond."

Deep in the layered forests lies a mysterious town perpetually shrouded in mist. The unique geography here, where cold winds from Yellow Rock Mountain mix with mist from geothermal springs, creates a dreamlike atmosphere. The townspeople living in this mist have developed their own unique belief system...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518402/52a29f28ef8cba48c37fb76c0e5daa1369d25bf7.png

In the game, players take on the role of the town's acting mayor, shouldering the responsibility of guiding the townspeople's faith and maintaining the town's operations. By developing the village, arranging follower positions, and wisely using various building facilities, players need to accumulate enough faith within limited rounds to pass the tests of the dark gods.

Core gameplay combines strategic card elements and resource management:

Use followers (cards) to gain faith and money resources
Build and place buildings to create optimal spatial configurations
Accumulate sufficient faith before each faith check


Our team is working toward creating a card management game with unique art style and strategic depth. In upcoming dev logs, we'll share more about card system design, character art, dark god mechanics, and more!

If you're interested in "Back of Beyond," please add the game to your wishlist: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539480/Back_of_Beyond/

Next time, we'll introduce the round mechanics and follower management system. Stay tuned!
